info.title: VCode public and authenticated API
info.description: Health, moderated comments, privacy-limited public analytics, authenticated website and distribution metrics, and guarded collaboration enquiries. Enquiry content is never sent to website analytics. Internal service endpoints and credentials are not part of this contract.

200.description: Blog service and database are ready

website.description: Spam honeypot; normal clients leave it empty.

303.description: Comment accepted and redirected to the article

post.description: Private Telegram callback receiver. It is unavailable while editorial integration is disabled.

200.description: Read-only aggregates for authorized registered public websites. Unavailable sites have null stats; daily nulls mean missing coverage. Prior-period comparison uses equal duration. No provider credentials are returned.

get.description: Versioned same-origin runtime for registered public applications; no automatic collection. VCode itself retains its legacy tracker route.

post.description: Registered site/origin and exact path only; no optional properties. Trusted edge overrides client metadata and supplies internal authorization. DNT/GPC suppress storage. No cookies or public analytics/admin access.

204.description: Accepted or suppressed by privacy preference

400.description: Unapproved site, incorrect origin or payload

get.description: Compatibility endpoint. No redirect; direct JSON up to 65536 bytes only after accepted publication. No functional release is active in preparation.

200.description: Latest accepted public release; immutable DMG download URL.

404.description: Distribution disabled, no accepted release or invalid catalog

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Exact immutable allowlisted file declared by the accepted catalog; no arbitrary path, query, encoded alias or symlink.

get.description: Read-only immutable approved installers and OSS compliance files. Never serves build/source directories or signing material. Requests are aggregate operational counts, not installations.

200.description: Exact hash-verified file or public metadata. MIME is selected from its approved installer/license/source type.

503.description: Artifact drift or storage failure; fail closed

post.description: Optional anonymous aggregate download intent for an accepted active release and approved notice. Same-origin browser request only, respects DNT/GPC, no visitor cookie, identity, URLs or referrer. Aggregate retention is 30 days.

204.description: Intent accepted or privacy preference suppressed recording

404.description: Collection disabled at the public edge

503.description: No approved active release or durable aggregate collection unavailable

get.summary: Check form activation and obtain a short-lived anti-spam challenge
get.description: Same-origin only, without query parameters. No visitor cookie is created or required. The form stays unavailable until its concrete privacy notice is approved and published and the service is activated for the same privacy version. An enabled challenge expires after ten minutes and cannot be submitted for at least 1.5 seconds. Responses are no-store. The disabled response contains no token.

200.description: Enabled challenge or disabled form state.

400.description: Invalid, unexpected or out-of-bounds fields; query parameters are not accepted.

403.description: Same-origin protection, the signed anti-spam challenge or the empty honeypot check failed.

429.description: Submission or anti-spam challenge rate limit reached.

503.description: The form is not activated, the reviewed privacy version is not configured, or a dependency is unavailable.

post.description: Same-origin JSON, at most 16 KiB, with strict field names and no query parameters. Field lengths apply to normalized Unicode text. Leave the honeypot empty. Generate a UUID requestId once for each enquiry and reuse it with identical content after an uncertain response; successful retries return the same reference. A 202 receipt means the enquiry and notification task were durably accepted; it does not promise Telegram delivery at that moment. Content is private, retained for at most 90 days, and excluded from Umami. Notification contains only a generic area, optional catalog app name, reference and dashboard link.

202.description: Enquiry accepted, or identical request already accepted.

400.description: Invalid, unexpected or out-of-bounds fields; query parameters are not accepted.

403.description: Same-origin protection, the signed anti-spam challenge or the empty honeypot check failed.

409.description: The request ID was previously used with a different normalized enquiry. Keep the same request ID when retrying unchanged content.

413.description: The uncompressed JSON request body exceeds 16 KiB.

415.description: Use application/json (optionally charset=utf-8) without compressed request content.

429.description: Submission or anti-spam challenge rate limit reached.

503.description: The form is not activated, the reviewed privacy version is not configured, or a dependency is unavailable.

get.summary: Read retained enquiries and aggregate enquiry counts
get.description: Requires a freshly verified admin account matching the configured owner ID and permission to the canonical VCode website. Items are the most recent retained enquiries (up to limit); summary covers all retained records. Interest covers the selected period and retained records only. Counts represent accepted enquiries, not unique people, and decrease when records are deleted or expire. Personal enquiry data and content are never sent to Umami, public endpoints, URLs or offline storage.

403.description: The account must be the configured owner, have the admin role and permission to the canonical VCode website. Mutations also require the exact same origin.

502.description: An authenticated dependency failed or returned an invalid response.

503.description: The enquiry inbox is not configured.

patch.description: Requires the same owner, admin and canonical VCode website permissions as the inbox. Exact same-origin JSON mutation. Status changes do not extend the original 90-day retention.

post.description: Same-origin public collector for registered applications. Exact approved public path and finite event names only. Source is a general public-service category on pageviews only. Portfolio footer events require separate site-specific approval. No target URLs, link text, accounts or cookies. DNT/GPC suppress collection. Trusted edge authorization stays server-side. VCode retains its legacy collector route.

204.description: Accepted or suppressed by privacy preference

400.description: Unapproved site, incorrect origin or payload

path.description: Exact registered general public path, without identifiers, query or fragment.

DownloadCounters.description: Numeric daily aggregates only; bytesWritten is file-body data written from the distribution service to its proxy, not client acknowledgment or installation.

DownloadMetrics.description: Requires a current authenticated account with permission to the canonical VCode website. Unconfigured or invalid data is unavailable with null totals. Operational counters are separate from website analytics; no visitor identities, referrers, cookies or project content.

ContactApplication.description: Canonical published portfolio ID. A private-deployment product may be selected as an enquiry topic; no private application URL is supplied.

startAt.description: Inclusive start of the selected period in Unix milliseconds.

endAt.description: Inclusive end of the selected period in Unix milliseconds.

received.description: Retained enquiries received during the period; not a count of unique people.

notifications.description: Current retained notification jobs by delivery state, independent of the selected interest period or inbox list limit. Failed means the bounded retry sequence was exhausted. Owner deletion and 90-day expiry remove these jobs and lower these counts; counts are not unique people.

ContactCatalogEntry.description: A public portfolio name; contains no service endpoints or private deployment information.

path.description: Exact approved public path. Private routes and arbitrary identifiers are rejected.

source.description: Only finite public-service categories; no original referral URL.

path.description: Exact approved public path. Private routes and arbitrary identifiers are rejected.

name.description: Each name must be explicitly approved for the site. The three portfolio names additionally require reviewed site-specific footer scope.
